a:["$","p",null,{"children":"Tarangire National Park is famous for its majestic baobab trees and large herds of elephants that roam freely across the park’s savannah. This park is home to one of the highest concentrations of wildlife outside the Serengeti ecosystem. Visitors can encounter giraffes, elands, impalas, and even rare species such as the fringe-eared oryx and greater kudu. Tarangire also boasts a rich birdlife, with over 500 species recorded, making it a paradise for birdwatchers."}]

c:["$","p",null,{"children":"Nestled at the base of the Great Rift Valley, Lake Manyara National Park is a hidden gem known for its tree-climbing lions – a rare and fascinating behavior not commonly seen elsewhere. The park also features lush groundwater forests, open grasslands, and the vast Lake Manyara itself, which attracts thousands of flamingos and other waterbirds. Hippos, baboons, and giraffes are frequently spotted, making this park a diverse and rewarding safari destination."}]
